<thought>We need to find a retrosynthetic template that corresponds to a Friedel‑Crafts acylation where a halide (e.g., Cl) is removed and an acyl group is introduced onto an aromatic ring, forming a new C–C bond. I will search the template catalog using a representative product SMILES (acetophenone) and specify that a halide is broken and an acyl group is formed, with a new aromatic‑sp2 C–C bond formed.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "CC(=O)c1ccccc1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["acyl"],
    "bonds_formed": ["6-6"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
